thread:
jen.support: FYI - customer (acct: 0xabc) reported that our autorouter called notify_voicemail instead of reset_password when they asked to reset via chat. Ticket #CS-9182. Observed at 2025-11-04.
sam.green: ugh. Do we have the raw request or sample? sounds like a schema fuzzy-match issue.
maria.devex: can you paste the payload and any router logs? :thinking:
jen.support: paste below — pretty minimal user message, no explicit "password" token, just "can't sign in, please help reset". Payload we sent to router:
```
{
  "user_id": "0xabc",
  "channel": "chat",
  "text": "i can't sign in, i need to reset my account",
  "meta": {"locale":"en-US", "platform":"web"}
}
```
jen.support: router log excerpt (redacted):
```
[router] trace id=fd9a selected tool=notify_voicemail score=0.78
[router] available: reset_password(score=0.75), notify_voicemail(0.78), escalate_ticket(0.62)
```
sam.green: looks like notify_voicemail edged out reset_password due to slightly higher score. Need to know why notify_voicemail had higher score — signature overlap? pinging leo.
leo.eng: quick context — notify_voicemail signature accepts free-text 'message' and 'user_id', while reset_password expects 'user_id' + either explicit 'reset_type' or a token like "reset","password" in text. Fuzzy matcher currently boosts endpoints accepting plain text. This exact phrasing slipped through.
maria.devex: consensus remediation options:
- short-term: add a higher priority/or negative bias for notify_voicemail when channel=="chat" && text contains signin/reset synonyms.
- medium: expand reset_password signature to include conversational intents (intent:reset) or a looser text match (but that might increase false positives elsewhere).
- workaround for support: manual invoke reset_password for CS-9182 and mark ticket as "manual routed".
jen.support: did the customer experience any side-effects? they got voicemail confirmation email (confusing) but no account change. Customer upset about confusion + delay.
leo.eng: repro steps for QA:
1) send payload above to router endpoint
2) observe selected tool and scores in trace
3) run with threshold delta=0.05 and compare
I can push a patch to the matcher heuristics to prefer explicit auth-related verbs for reset_password. Will open PR.
sam.green: please also add an integration test that covers short auth phrases without explicit keywords — we should prefer auth flows when 'sign in' or 'can't access' present.
router-bot: NOTE: created incident draft #IR-472 with details from thread. Assign to leo.eng.
jen.support: thanks team. Doing manual reset now and messaging customer. Keep me posted on PR ETA. :thumbsup:
